# beta:metrics:all on R7 `badcc20d` (179 pages, default view)

Run: `cd tools && node beta/metrics.js --all --out <scratch>/all.json` on a detached worktree at badcc20d. Note: part of this sweep overlapped the screenshot runs, so its FCP column is pessimistic; the Tokyo budget re-runs in [budgets-r7.md](budgets-r7.md) were taken on an idle container. B-06, B-07 and B-09 read the R6 Atlas DOM (`.mappane`, the tray, `pin-n` labels) and cannot see the map-search layout; they also failed on all 84 pages in R6's default-view sweep (B-06, B-09). See ROUND-7 §Method.
